description: Use this when the user wants to mail printed cards to people at US postal addresses and gives the addresses as pasted text, a CSV, or an .xlsx spreadsheet. Reads names and addresses, checks each against USPS data, and saves them as a recipient list. Returns a list_id, how many rows are ready, and the problem for each row that needs fixing. Up to 300 recipients; pass list_id to append rows to an existing list. US addresses only. Not for e-cards or email, addresses outside the US, or advertising mail to purchased or rented lists.

address_file.description: A CSV or XLSX file the user attached.

addresses_text.description: Addresses as pasted text or CSV. One recipient per line ("Name, Street, City, ST ZIP") or a CSV with a header row.

name: import_address_list
title: Import address list
